title: Bazel android example still need add --spawn_strategy=standalone when build on mac

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
### Environment info
* Operating System:
Mac OS X 10.12.2 (16C67)
* Bazel version (output of `bazel info release`):
0.4.4-homebrew

I basically try to build the [example android project](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/tree/master/examples/android). However, if I follow the README, bazel will give me this error:

```
➜  bazel_android_test bazel build //android/java/bazel:hello_world
WARNING: Bazel Android NDK crosstools are based on Android NDK revision 12. The revision of the Android NDK given in android_ndk_repository rule 'androidndk' is '14.0.3675639-beta2'.
INFO: Found 1 target...
ERROR: /private/var/tmp/_bazel_YingnanWang/e66eaf7095002f1ad1ac35cfaac2ae23/external/androidsdk/com.android.support/BUILD:3785:1: Processing Android resources for @androidsdk//com.android.support:support-compat-25.2.0 failed: Process exited with status 2 [sandboxed].
Error parsing command line: While parsing option --primaryData: invalid UnvalidatedAndroidData: bazel-out/android-arm-linux-androideabi-4.9-v7a-gnu-libstdcpp-fastbuild/bin/external/androidsdk/com.android.support/_aar/unzipped/resources/support-compat-25.2.0 does not exist
Try --help.
Use --strategy=AndroidAapt=standalone to disable sandboxing for the failing actions.
Target //android/java/bazel:hello_world failed to build
Use --verbose_failures to see the command lines of failed build steps.
INFO: Elapsed time: 20.734s, Critical Path: 10.19s
```

My WORKSPACE is:
```
android_sdk_repository(
    name = "androidsdk",
    path = "/Users/YingnanWang/Library/Android/sdk",
    api_level = 25,
    build_tools_version="25.0.2"
)

android_ndk_repository(
    name = "androidndk",
    # Replace with path to Android NDK on your system
    path = "/Users/YingnanWang/Library/Android/sdk/ndk-bundle",
    # Replace with the Android NDK API level
    api_level = 24
)
```

My BUILD file is:
```
filegroup(
    name = "srcs",
    srcs = glob(["**"]),
    visibility = ["//android:__pkg__"],
)

android_library(
    name = "lib",
    srcs = ["Lib.java"],
)

android_binary(
    name = "hello_world",
    srcs = glob([
        "MainActivity.java",
        "Jni.java",
    ]),
    manifest = "AndroidManifest.xml",
    resource_files = glob(["res/**"]),
    deps = [
        ":jni",
        ":lib",
        "@androidsdk//com.android.support:appcompat-v7-25.2.0",
    ],
)

cc_library(
    name = "jni",
    srcs = ["jni.cc"],
    deps = [":jni_dep"],
)

cc_library(
    name = "jni_dep",
    srcs = ["jni_dep.cc"],
    hdrs = ["jni_dep.h"],
)
```

If I add the `--spawn_strategy=standalone`, build pass.
